scenes.label: 30% of a $5,000 monthly income, before taxes
scenes.say: The common rule: keep housing under thirty percent of gross income. On five thousand a month, that's fifteen hundred.

scenes.label: of US renter households paid more than that in 2023
scenes.say: In twenty twenty three, about half of American renters paid more than that.
